mapper.select: SELECT bv.vaccination_no, bv.baby_no, bv.schedule_no, bv.vaccine_name, bv.dose_label, bv.recommended_month, bv.completed, bv.completed_date, bv.hospital_name, bv.is_custom, bv.reg_time FROM tbl_baby_vaccination bv JOIN tbl_baby_info bi ON bv.baby_no = bi.baby_no WHERE bv.baby_no = #{babyNo} AND bi.email = #{email} ORDER BY bv.recommended_month, bv.vaccination_no

SELECT bv.vaccination_no, bv.baby_no, bv.schedule_no, bv.vaccine_name, bv.dose_label, bv.recommended_month, bv.completed, bv.completed_date, bv.hospital_name, bv.is_custom, bv.reg_time FROM tbl_baby_vaccination bv JOIN tbl_baby_info bi ON bv.baby_no = bi.baby_no WHERE bv.vaccination_no = #{vaccinationNo} AND bi.email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tbl_baby_vaccination (baby_no, schedule_no, vaccine_name, dose_label, recommended_month, completed, is_custom) SELECT #{babyNo}, schedule_no, vaccine_name, dose_label, recommended_month, false, false FROM tbl_vaccine_schedule ORDER BY display_order

INSERT INTO tbl_baby_vaccination (baby_no, vaccine_name, recommended_month, completed, completed_date, hospital_name, is_custom) VALUES (#{babyNo}, #{vaccineName}, #{recommendedMonth}, #{completed}, #{completedDate}, #{hospitalName}, true)
